title: Constant coordinate of a satisfying assignment
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, and let $z$ be an assignment over $$ to the circuit’s quadratic variables. If $z$ satisfies every equation in the circuit’s associated homogeneous quadratic system, then its constant coordinate is $1$.

An assignment to its quadratic variables
The assignment satisfies every equation in the associated homogeneous quadratic system
